review.description: Expanded existing report-outcome meaning to include an invalid defect claim and a defect already fixed in inspected source; retained stable ID/name and separation from processing/delivery. No consumer links enter the foundational definition.
review.implementation: Report.Outcome retains string serialization and now receives invalid or resolved only through deterministic disposition settlement. Foundational definition remains a meaning rather than workflow instructions; old filed, duplicate and explained behavior remain represented.
review.tests: Service assertions read stored outcome and prohibit issue creation on invalid/resolved. Browser assertions distinguish completed outcomes from independent Unknown release and installed evidence; no new coverage is claimed for untouched terms or installed hosts.
